headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high‑flying firms and modest performance from the majors.
summary: Coforge posted a 53.6% YoY revenue surge, the strongest in the sector. Most peers delivered double‑digit growth, but Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% revenue growth. AI‑related services were a common driver, contributing to higher margins for several companies. Guidance remains cautious, with many firms expecting modest FY27 growth.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI services helped lift revenue and profit at Infosys, LTM, HCLTech, TCS and Mphasis.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin guidance to 16% and HCLTech reported an operating margin of 18.2%.

themes.title: Revenue growth variance
themes.detail: Growth ranged from 1.5% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge, highlighting divergent market positioning.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.

domain_outlook.note: Mphasis highlighted telecom and device engineering growth, indicating demand in the sector.
